already_done.text: Re-deciding the federation vendor (already chosen: Apollo).
Re-deciding strangler vs rewrite (already decided: strangler).

decisions.rationale: No rewrite; v1 REST clients untouched behind the SLA freeze.
decisions.text: Strangler facade: a GraphQL gateway in front of the existing REST services.

decisions.rationale: Subgraph ownership matches the microservice org structure.
Biggest latency win: 14 calls collapse to 2.
decisions.text: Migrate the mobile launch screen first.

decisions.rationale: Enterprise SLA freezes v1 REST clients until Q2.
decisions.text: Keep REST as the system of record through Q2.

facts.text: The app makes 14 REST calls on launch; p95 is 1.8s.
No breaking changes for v1 REST clients until Q2.
The GraphQL layer must hold p95 under 300ms.
The backend team has no production GraphQL experience; training is budgeted.
GraphQL would collapse the launch sequence to 2 calls.

must_not_state.text: Proposing to deprecate or shut down REST now (frozen until Q2).
Proposing to rewrite services in GraphQL (strangler, not rewrite).
Claiming the current 1.8s p95 is acceptable.

next_actions.text: Stand up the federation gateway in staging (owner: mobile platform, due Nov 1).
Write the launch-screen subgraph (owner: feed team).
Define the schema governance RFC (owner: staff eng).
Book GraphQL training for backend engineers (owner: eng manager).

open_questions.text: Who owns federated schema governance: a single team or a council?
How are N+1 queries prevented: dataloader discipline or review?
What is the rollback trigger if p95 exceeds 300ms in prod?

objective: Plan the REST to GraphQL migration for the mobile app.
